jobs.caption: Dark aggressive phonk trap instrumental at 140 BPM: a tense filtered intro with a ticking hi-hat riser and rising white-noise sweep for the first 8 seconds, then a massive drop with a distorted 808 sub bass that glides, punchy hard kicks on every beat, crisp snares and rapid hi-hat rolls, a cowbell phonk melody, sidechain pumping, a second drop with an even heavier bass, loud modern club mix, no vocals
